data.total_networks_note: mainnet networks only; networks[] includes testnets flagged by is_mainnet
data.avg_uptime_method: per-service mean of the latest daily uptime rollup

traction.method: dedup on settlement identity (network,tx_hash,log_index); do not sum per-service figures; measured_networks are network abbreviations, the per-service traction block uses CAIP-2 ids; coverage_of_measured_flow_pct is the listed dedup volume as a share of the flow measurable by our tracked settlers (the facilitator daily volume we measure, not the whole ecosystem); top_10_services_share_pct is the top 10 services' share of the same 30d dedup volume; both are precomputed hourly and null until the first refresh
traction.caveat: measured across listed services, a measured floor over 30d, not an ecosystem total; USDC via measured facilitators only

on_chain_measurement.note: On-chain settlement is measured from a harvest floor and networks began on different dates; measured_since is the earliest measured network and all_networks_measured_since is the date from which every measured network contributes. Aggregates over windows starting before these dates are partial.

data.facilitator_volume_note: Aggregate facilitator settlement volume over 30 days across measured facilitators; a superset of the listed-services flow, not de-duplicated on settlement identity.
